S.FORM: == Yanaihara Tadao == Yanaihara Tadao , o cecay hakasi no Dipong to kicay ato satao' no picalap hakasi. Itiya 1951 miheca 12 folad tangasa 1957 miheca 12 folad mala'a'isidan no Tokyo daykako; o kaying no Dipong haksuyin; mapakaolah to toloay tamohong at cecay parina'an. Masowal to "Cifaloco'ay no Dipong a tamdaw" sanay. 'Orip Kalakapahan to'ek I 1893 miheca 1 folad 27 romi'ad, masofoc ci Yanaihara Tadao i Ehime ken Ochi-gun Tonda-mura Shikoku no Dipong; o mama nao tayraay to i Kyoto minanam to sakala ising, saka o saratay i Ehime ken a isingan. 11 ko mihecaan mitilid i Kope sokakko kotoka, saka tosa miheca maala to Hyoko kenritsu Kope cukakko limaay miheca. I 1910 miheca, aala ko Kyusei daiici kotokakko, i pikerid no kakaay ci Shisen seibu mikihatiya to 'a'isidan ci Shin Watanabe kome-en a pisa'osi kay (Dokusho kurabu) sa'opo, saka tosa miheca mikihatiya to ni Uchimura kanzo Seisho kenkyukai i loma' to pa'aliwacan, ikor malo awaayay ko kiwkay Kristokiw a mitooray. I 1913 miheca 9 folad, micomod i Tokyo teikoku daikaku hogakubu mitilid, mafiyol ni Shin Watanabe kome-en ko katayra ala singsi to "satao' no picalap" (Shokuminchiseisaku) a hakasi itiya. Lakapahan to'ek I 1916 miheca, masawad to Daykako i, matayal i "Bieji kōgyō kenkyūjo" no Sumitomo gurūpu itiya; i 1920 miheca 3 folad, malasingsi no Tōkyōteikokudaigaku keizaigakubu, 10 folad maocor tayra i Europ Ammilika mitilid, itiya i London a Toynbee Hall ato London Seiji keizaigakubu citodongay mitilid; i 1923 miheca 2 folad minokay, toya mihecaan 8 folad macakat mala hakasi, micada to nipasafana' ni Shin Watanabe kome-en ko katayra ala singsi to "satao' no picalap" (Shokuminchiseisaku) pasifana'. I pitilid ningra i roma kitakit i, misa'imer cingra to pakayniay no ka'etipay nisatekeday (nicowatay) picalap a sakowan, ka o syakay kakak ko pinengneng caay ko pisadadahal to nisatekeday sakowan no Dipong to niyah a sra ano eca sa'icel mikowan, saan o no Kristokiw ko pikihar to nicalapan piepec to syakay a pikelot, mipasimo'ecelay ko misakakinih to nicalapan a tamdaw. I 1920 miheca, mafiyol to harateng ni Marx, adihay ko pacefad ningra to sihong a kacowat ato nisatekeday pikowan no Dipong, nicalapay pikowan a pahimerac. Mipasifana' sa oni Adam Smith "sakadafoh no kitakit", ni David Ricardo a "Kicay ha", ni Vladimir Lenin "nisatekeday pikowan" a no'etipay a kicayha ko sapasifana', saan o ni J. A. Hobson "nisatekeday sakowan" ko patatengaan mikilim to nai nisatekeday sakowan a kalali'aca kinaira i nicalapan ko saka picalap pikingkiw. I 1926 miheca (Shōwa gan'nen), o soto no Taywan ci Izawa Taka o mala Tokyo sico i; paini ci Yanaihara Tadao to "tosa so'ot finawlan no Tokyo si ato sepatay so'ot finawlan no kanatal" sanay a tilid tayra i "Teikoku daigaku zasshi" mihapiw, pacefad to nisatekeday pikowan a Sotofo no Taywan. I 1927 miheca (Showa 2-nen) 3 folad tangasa 4 folad, tayra cingra i Taywan misolap; misolap maledef i Taypi, Taoyin, Ciapansan, Taycong, Tongse, Cusan, Ciayi, Taynan, Takao, Pintong, Sinco, Yilan, kalingko, Taytong a niyaro'. minengneng cingra to Kaysya, omah, pitilidan, niyaro' no yincumin, pakayni ci Cai Peihuoan miliso' to kakeridan no Taywan, nika i pihapiw ningra makantok no imeng no Dipong, matena' no miliyangay sakapot "awaayay ko dafong a sakapot"; maratatenga cangra ca Lin Xiantang, aci Cai Peihuo to picikeroh to misdeal to finawlan a onto, caay ka pacekil ko misatekeday pikowan no sotofo no Taywan. Patikol i Dipong, itira cingra patilid haca cingra i "Teikoku daigaku zasshi" to mihapiw "saki Taywan no sici a pakonira" sanay a tilid, mipacefad to cango'otay no Taywan to sici pakonira ato nisowalan citodongay:awaay ko niyah Taywan tamdaw a sinpong, halo i Tokyo nipasadakan no Taywan a "sinpong no Taywan finawlan" caay ka nga'ay patayra milinah i Taywan; halo, o paini ningra "caay ko kafana'en koya misatekiday to sici a tamdaw, katayra ho i Taywan a minengneng." I 1937 miheca (Showa 13-nen), macowat ko demak no Rokokyo jiken itiya, itira cingra i "Chuo yoron" mihapiw to "sakanga'ay no kitakit" (Kokka riso), paheci to sakanga'ay no kitakit i sakimo'ecelay, sakaeca kaenec no ki'emelay i sasafaay a tamdaw ko solongoc; toya mihecaan 12 folad, papelo itira i Tokyo teikoku daigaku to sapisawad hapiw, milaha cingra i ka'ayaw "mi'orip to sakanga'ay no kitakit" (Kokka riso), 'ayawen ko pitadem tonini a kitakit." saan. 1945 miheca 11 folad, mapatiyol palowad ko kalahakasi i Tokyo daigaku; i 1946 miheca 8 folad, citodong to kakeridan no Tokyo daigaku shakai kagakuken kyujo; i 1947 miheca, pakaala to Tokyo daigaku keizaigaku hakushi; 1948 miheca, maala ko kala Keizai daijin (Keizaigaku bu-cho); 1949 miheca, mala Shodai bungakubu-gaku bucho; 1951 miheca, mala Dai 16-dai Tokyo daigaku socho ('a'isidan no Tokyo daikaku), tangsa 1957 miheca ira ko 2 liyad polong 6 mihecaan; 1952 miheca, o pikiki no mitiliday itiya micomod i pitilidan misolap ko imeng (Tokyo daigaku po po Ra jiken), misa'imer cingra to niyah pikowan to pakoniyah a pikingkiw sanay pa'icel. Kato'asan miheca I 1958 miheca, cingangan to Meiyo kyoju; 1961 miheca, ciadada to kang no fitoka a mapatay, 68 miheca ko 'orip i hekal. Mapatireng laloma' no Tokyo daigaku ko Yanaihara Tadao fawahan, itatihi mapatireng ko "Yanaihara Tadao Niwa". Pahemak ci Ienaga saburo o Rekishiya no Dipong "o faloco' no Dipong a tamdaw" saan. Pahemem ci Rin shenjin o matiliday no Taywan "talacowa caay ko masa Max (Marukusu) a tamdaw, ka o "okak ko sapitilid, o cohel ko cengel", miliyang to picalap milood to Congko; talacowa ciraraw to mikowanay, macefis ko kalahakasi malasingsi, oyaan to ko faloco', o lalekoan no to'as a pinangan" . S.FORM: == Yanaihara Tadao == Yanaihara Tadao , o cecay hakasi no Dipong to kicay ato satao' no picalap hakasi. Itiya 1951 miheca 12 folad tangasa 1957 miheca 12 folad mala'a'isidan no Tokyo daykako; o kaying no Dipong haksuyin; mapakaolah to toloay tamohong at cecay parina'an. Masowal to "Cifaloco'ay no Dipong a tamdaw" sanay. 'Orip Kalakapahan to'ek I 1893 miheca 1 folad 27 romi'ad, masofoc ci Yanaihara Tadao i Ehime ken Ochi-gun Tonda-mura Shikoku no Dipong; o mama nao tayraay to i Kyoto minanam to sakala ising, saka o saratay i Ehime ken a isingan. 11 ko mihecaan mitilid i Kope sokakko kotoka, saka tosa miheca maala to Hyoko kenritsu Kope cukakko limaay miheca. I 1910 miheca, aala ko Kyusei daiici kotokakko, i pikerid no kakaay ci Shisen seibu mikihatiya to 'a'isidan ci Shin Watanabe kome-en a pisa'osi kay (Dokusho kurabu) sa'opo, saka tosa miheca mikihatiya to ni Uchimura kanzo Seisho kenkyukai i loma' to pa'aliwacan, ikor malo awaayay ko kiwkay Kristokiw a mitooray. I 1913 miheca 9 folad, micomod i Tokyo teikoku daikaku hogakubu mitilid, mafiyol ni Shin Watanabe kome-en ko katayra ala singsi to "satao' no picalap" (Shokuminchiseisaku) a hakasi itiya. Lakapahan to'ek I 1916 miheca, masawad to Daykako i, matayal i "Bieji kōgyō kenkyūjo" no Sumitomo gurūpu itiya; i 1920 miheca 3 folad, malasingsi no Tōkyōteikokudaigaku keizaigakubu, 10 folad maocor tayra i Europ Ammilika mitilid, itiya i London a Toynbee Hall ato London Seiji keizaigakubu citodongay mitilid; i 1923 miheca 2 folad minokay, toya mihecaan 8 folad macakat mala hakasi, micada to nipasafana' ni Shin Watanabe kome-en ko katayra ala singsi to "satao' no picalap" (Shokuminchiseisaku) pasifana'. I pitilid ningra i roma kitakit i, misa'imer cingra to pakayniay no ka'etipay nisatekeday (nicowatay) picalap a sakowan, ka o syakay kakak ko pinengneng caay ko pisadadahal to nisatekeday sakowan no Dipong to niyah a sra ano eca sa'icel mikowan, saan o no Kristokiw ko pikihar to nicalapan piepec to syakay a pikelot, mipasimo'ecelay ko misakakinih to nicalapan a tamdaw. I 1920 miheca, mafiyol to harateng ni Marx, adihay ko pacefad ningra to sihong a kacowat ato nisatekeday pikowan no Dipong, nicalapay pikowan a pahimerac. Mipasifana' sa oni Adam Smith "sakadafoh no kitakit", ni David Ricardo a "Kicay ha", ni Vladimir Lenin "nisatekeday pikowan" a no'etipay a kicayha ko sapasifana', saan o ni J. A. Hobson "nisatekeday sakowan" ko patatengaan mikilim to nai nisatekeday sakowan a kalali'aca kinaira i nicalapan ko saka picalap pikingkiw. I 1926 miheca (Shōwa gan'nen), o soto no Taywan ci Izawa Taka o mala Tokyo sico i; paini ci Yanaihara Tadao to "tosa so'ot finawlan no Tokyo si ato sepatay so'ot finawlan no kanatal" sanay a tilid tayra i "Teikoku daigaku zasshi" mihapiw, pacefad to nisatekeday pikowan a Sotofo no Taywan. I 1927 miheca (Showa 2-nen) 3 folad tangasa 4 folad, tayra cingra i Taywan misolap; misolap maledef i Taypi, Taoyin, Ciapansan, Taycong, Tongse, Cusan, Ciayi, Taynan, Takao, Pintong, Sinco, Yilan, kalingko, Taytong a niyaro'. minengneng cingra to Kaysya, omah, pitilidan, niyaro' no yincumin, pakayni ci Cai Peihuoan miliso' to kakeridan no Taywan, nika i pihapiw ningra makantok no imeng no Dipong, matena' no miliyangay sakapot "awaayay ko dafong a sakapot"; maratatenga cangra ca Lin Xiantang, aci Cai Peihuo to picikeroh to misdeal to finawlan a onto, caay ka pacekil ko misatekeday pikowan no sotofo no Taywan. Patikol i Dipong, itira cingra patilid haca cingra i "Teikoku daigaku zasshi" to mihapiw "saki Taywan no sici a pakonira" sanay a tilid, mipacefad to cango'otay no Taywan to sici pakonira ato nisowalan citodongay:awaay ko niyah Taywan tamdaw a sinpong, halo i Tokyo nipasadakan no Taywan a "sinpong no Taywan finawlan" caay ka nga'ay patayra milinah i Taywan; halo, o paini ningra "caay ko kafana'en koya misatekiday to sici a tamdaw, katayra ho i Taywan a minengneng." I 1937 miheca (Showa 13-nen), macowat ko demak no Rokokyo jiken itiya, itira cingra i "Chuo yoron" mihapiw to "sakanga'ay no kitakit" (Kokka riso), paheci to sakanga'ay no kitakit i sakimo'ecelay, sakaeca kaenec no ki'emelay i sasafaay a tamdaw ko solongoc; toya mihecaan 12 folad, papelo itira i Tokyo teikoku daigaku to sapisawad hapiw, milaha cingra i ka'ayaw "mi'orip to sakanga'ay no kitakit" (Kokka riso), 'ayawen ko pitadem tonini a kitakit." saan. 1945 miheca 11 folad, mapatiyol palowad ko kalahakasi i Tokyo daigaku; i 1946 miheca 8 folad, citodong to kakeridan no Tokyo daigaku shakai kagakuken kyujo; i 1947 miheca, pakaala to Tokyo daigaku keizaigaku hakushi; 1948 miheca, maala ko kala Keizai daijin (Keizaigaku bu-cho); 1949 miheca, mala Shodai bungakubu-gaku bucho; 1951 miheca, mala Dai 16-dai Tokyo daigaku socho ('a'isidan no Tokyo daikaku), tangsa 1957 miheca ira ko 2 liyad polong 6 mihecaan; 1952 miheca, o pikiki no mitiliday itiya micomod i pitilidan misolap ko imeng (Tokyo daigaku po po Ra jiken), misa'imer cingra to niyah pikowan to pakoniyah a pikingkiw sanay pa'icel. Kato'asan miheca I 1958 miheca, cingangan to Meiyo kyoju; 1961 miheca, ciadada to kang no fitoka a mapatay, 68 miheca ko 'orip i hekal. Mapatireng laloma' no Tokyo daigaku ko Yanaihara Tadao fawahan, itatihi mapatireng ko "Yanaihara Tadao Niwa". Pahemak ci Ienaga saburo o Rekishiya no Dipong "o faloco' no Dipong a tamdaw" saan. Pahemem ci Rin shenjin o matiliday no Taywan "talacowa caay ko masa Max (Marukusu) a tamdaw, ka o "okak ko sapitilid, o cohel ko cengel", miliyang to picalap milood to Congko; talacowa ciraraw to mikowanay, macefis ko kalahakasi malasingsi, oyaan to ko faloco', o lalekoan no to'as a pinangan" .
